data.exact_reserve_text:
The result for the year has been impacted by lower than expected premium growth as well as reserve strengthening on prior year losses.
The increase relative to the prior year is a combination of adverse developments on 2017 and 2018 catastrophe events, most notably the Southern Californian Wildfires and the Mexican Earthquake, and increases to the 2018 year of account ex-cat loss ratios.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2019 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 93.96m. Using the reported gross claims development triangle, the movement on prior years (2017 and earlier) aggregates to effectively nil, so no material prior-year release or strengthening is measurable by the triangle method. Narrative in the report however states there was reserve strengthening on prior year losses driven by adverse developments on 2017 and 2018 catastrophe events (notably California wildfires and a Mexican earthquake) and increases to ex-cat loss ratios in 2018. Major individually-named 2018 events (Hurricane Michael, California Wildfires, Hurricane Florence, Typhoon Mangkhut and others) materially impacted results in 2018; 2019 saw several named wind events (Dorian, Faxai, Hagibis) with smaller net impacts. Overall, the explicit gross prior-year movement is nil by the gross triangle, but narrative indicates adverse prior-year development across property catastrophe events.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening claims outstanding taken from balance sheet (liabilities, Claims outstanding, 2018 comparative). There is no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' note; prior year development was derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) which shows no net movement for underwriting years <=2017, hence prior_year_development_gbp_m = 0.0. Narrative in the report states 'reserve strengthening on prior year losses' and cites adverse development on 2017/2018 catastrophe events; this indicates some adverse development but no gross quantified movement for 2017-and-prior is provided elsewhere. lob_movements amounts are not quantified by LOB in the report and are therefore null. All top-level monetary amounts are converted to millions. Claims development triangle values are presented in the triangle in original units (thousands).
